capabilities: Writes angle bracket links for paths containing spaces
Adds a leading ./ to relative links
Converts existing links in a selection, note, folder or vault
Overrides Obsidian's wikilink and link path settings
extras: Documentation is a separate demo vault shipped with each release and openable via a command; beta versions install through BRAT; the plugin also publishes a generateMarkdownLinkExtended() API for other plugin developers.
intentEvidence: Alternative space handling: angle-bracketed paths; spaces preserved
motivation: Wikilinks are not part of the Markdown spec, so a vault that uses them stops making sense outside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian writes Markdown links with %20-escaped spaces and relative paths without a leading ./, which are hard to read and resolve differently in other editors.

relations.evidence: renames and deletes are handled by Advanced Rename and Delete Handler, which this plugin offers to install
Backlink Cache speeds this plugin up on a large vault.
Advanced Metadata Cache, with its Names module on, speeds up resolving links via aliases
Alternative alias handling: explicit rewrite to a unique target
Alternative space handling: angle-bracketed paths; spaces preserved
Broader conversion: selections/folders, angle brackets, leading ./ and automatic save-time conversion

summary: Plugin that makes Obsidian write Markdown links with angle brackets and explicit ./ relative paths, and converts existing links to that form.
